- [x] I have updated 'mini.nvim' to latest version of the `main` branch

### Module(s)

mini.files

### Neovim version

0.12.x

### Description

When I try to create a new folder named Abstracts or a file, it always throws an error even though the file has been created, and it freezes when using mini.files, forcing me to restart nvim.

```
E5108: Lua: ...are/nvim/site/pack/core/opt/mini.nvim/lua/mini/files.lua:2437: bad argument #1 to 'ipairs' (table expected, got nil) [+6](9) 
```

### Reproduction

1. Create Folder in Dotnet project
2. Click O -> Abstracts/ -> Change to Normal mode -> Ctrl + S (Enter) -> Choice to Save (yes) 
3. Bugs: 
-  `E5108: Lua: ...are/nvim/site/pack/core/opt/mini.nvim/lua/mini/files.lua:2437: bad argument #1 to 'ipairs' (table expected, got nil) [+6](9) `
- Can't interact with the mini.files, only can ctrl + H to comback the buffer (mini.file not close) and can't open again

Thanks for the issue! Since it is already closed, I assume it was the problem on the config side?

> 2\. Click O -> Abstracts/ -> Change to Normal mode -> Ctrl + S (Enter) -> Choice to Save (yes)

This indicates some custom config (the `Ctrl + S (Enter)` part). If the issue persists, I'd ask for a full 'mini.files' config.

Also, line numbers don't match neither latest `main` nor latest release. Updating to the latest `main` should be the first thing to do when trying to reproduce the issue.

problem at sort function (I comment it)

> problem at sort function (I comment it)

I am afraid the whole config relies on monkey-patched version of `MiniFiles` global variable, which is not advised. Besides that, without `return MiniFiles.gitignore:sort_entries(smart_hlsearch(fs_entries))` part (which is not present), the `config.content.sort` function works on its own. And there is no explanation of what `Ctrl + S (Enter)` means here, which I'd assume matters somehow.

But yeah, as is it doesn't really look like 'mini.files' issue per se.
